source:
[u][b]The Dangerous Kouhai Halfling Oppai Spy![/b][/u]
Race: Halfing
Code Name: Gothic
First Year at Espiona Girls' Academy
Assigned Class: Wolfard
Club: Spy Goth-Loli Club

Vivian is a first-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and a halfling. She is one of the top students in the Wolfard class, which specializes in assassination and combat.

Halflings were generally seen as small, plain, and unremarkable compared to other races. Vivian dislikes that perception and works hard every day to raise the status of her race. Coming from a lineage of assassins, her dual-knife combat style is fierce and merciless. While achieving results in battle, she also dresses in her favorite gothic lolita fashion, making sure her appearance stands out as well.

Despite her cute looks, she has a blunt and fearless personality. She does not speak much, but when she does, she says exactly what she means in a sharp and direct way. She also seeks attention and steps forward boldly, driven by her desire to elevate her race’s reputation. Though she can be hard to approach, she has a strong sense of camaraderie.

She believes that taking down the protagonist, a ninja from another world, would earn her a massive score, and she constantly targets him. As a result, the protagonist’s daily routine consists of dodging Vivian’s attacks while engaging in sexual harassment, all while going about his school life. As she continues to pursue him, a different kind of feeling may begin to stir within her…

Her codename is “Gothic,” derived from her love of gothic lolita fashion. Her ability as a spy lies in assassination techniques using her twin knives. These knives are custom-made favorites that she carefully maintains every day while humming to herself.

Her boobs are N-cups, with a “dangerously alluring half-sphere” shape. To ensure halflings are not looked down on, she performs bust enhancement massages every single day. Her specialty in honey traps is a lolita-style approach that strongly appeals to certain targets. However, she finds honey traps bothersome and would rather resort to threatening with her knives in the end.

Her hobbies include competitive eating and nighttime walks. Her specialties are costume-making and knife handling.

Her mother, Victoria, is a teacher at the academy who teaches home economics and assassination techniques. She is known as a mysterious woman with a unique presence and intimidating aura. They often make outfits together, and their relationship is very close.
